tools.name: what_applies
tools.description: Which EU and national consumer rules apply to an online shop that sells to consumers in the given EU countries, with what the shop must show, the date each rule applies from, the official source, and the free Shopproof feature that covers it. Full detail for the EU and Austria, Germany, France, Ital

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: One Shopproof rule by its ID (such as DE-WD-01 or EU-PS-01): the requirement, what the shop must do, the date, the legal basis and the official source. Technical help, not legal advice.

tools.name: search_rules
tools.description: Search the published Shopproof rules for EU online shops by words (for example "withdrawal button", "GPSR manufacturer", "battery take-back"), optionally for one country. Returns IDs, titles, dates and official sources. Technical help, not legal advice.

tools.name: upcoming_deadlines
tools.description: Rules for EU online shops that start applying in the coming days (default 90), for the EU and optionally chosen countries, each with the date and the official source. Technical help, not legal advice.

tools.name: withdrawal_wording
tools.description: The wording for the EU withdrawal button and its confirmation button (Directive (EU) 2023/2673): the reviewed national wording for Austria, Germany, France, Italy and the Netherlands with alternatives, or the directive wording in any of the 24 official EU languages, each with the official source.

tools.name: check_shop
tools.description: Runs the free Shopproof shop check on a public shop address: withdrawal button and information, legal notice, dispute statement, price display, product safety details, accessibility basics and more, for customers in AT, DE, FR, IT or NL. Reads only public pages and takes up to 30 seconds. Limited to

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Finds the shopproof.app guide for a topic (withdrawal button, guarantee notice, GPSR, accessibility, batteries, packaging, IOSS, EU responsible person and more), optionally step by step for Shopify, WooCommerce or Shopware, in English, German, French, Italian or Dutch.

tools.name: install_links
tools.description: Links to install the free Shopproof app or plugin for Shopify, WooCommerce, Shopware or JTL-Shop, and the free Shopproof Accessibility and Restock plugins for WooCommerce.
